div.h2: Hiring is looked after by the hiring team
div.p: This is where every request for a new person lives — who asked, whether there is budget for it, who agreed it, and how the candidates are getting on. If you run a part of the business you can raise a request here; ask your HR administrator to put your name against your department and this screen fills in.
Every request for a new person, from the moment somebody asks to the moment the advert goes out.

div.p: A hiring rule says, per company and country, who picks a request up once it has been agreed and who their manager is. Without one a role is still agreed perfectly well — it just sits with nobody recruiting it, and Payobook chases the hiring administrators about it every day. It is one line to write.

div.p: Open a role on the Roles tab, find the candidate you want to meet and press Arrange.
